title: How I get through the 3 p.m. slump at work
dek: The middle of the afternoon is when energy dips for many of us, and a few simple habits help more than another snack.
keywords: how to stay focused in the afternoon
body: It is three o'clock, and if you are anything like me, your focus has wandered off somewhere. The words on the screen look the same as they did an hour ago, and the snack drawer is calling.
I used to fight this with sugar and a second coffee. That worked for about twenty minutes and then left me more tired, especially on nights when I wanted to sleep well.

Now I try something simpler. I stand up and walk for five minutes, even if it is only to refill my water glass and look out a window. I drink a full glass of water. Then I switch to a task that needs less deep thinking, like filing, replying to easy messages or planning tomorrow.
Saving the easy work for this part of the day has helped me a lot. I stop blaming myself for the dip and start working with it.
Right now, stand up, get a glass of water and choose one small, easy task to finish before four.
